claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.falsifier: After deploy, a staged kernel or pending capsule is not booted within a day, or the journal shows 'Outside of configured reboot window, skipping.' at a 05:00 run.
claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.statement: paphos applies LVFS firmware at 04:30 and reboots for a pending capsule at 06:00 inside its window, and its upgrade reboots land inside 05:00-06:30.

claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.falsifier: After enrollment and an upgrade reboot, paphos waits for the passphrase on initrd SSH port 2222.
claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.statement: After Tang enrollment, paphos reboots in its 05:00-06:30 window and unlocks its LUKS root without a passphrase.

claim:ci-review-gate-readings.statement: With statusPrefix set, review-gate posts <statusPrefix>/review = success when the newest review of the exact head by the reviewer has no open blocking finding, and failure when it has one. A review of an older head gives no status, and an unchanged result is not posted again.

plan.intent: den PR 4 of AEC task M (Chorus f4bbad07, bead aec-16x.2), part (h) with den plan P4: a generic review gate in .dagger/modules/ci. Five optional settings, each empty by default: statusPrefix (the gate posts the commit status <statusPrefix>/review; empty turns the gate off), reviewMarker (the name of a machine-readable block in the review body of the reviewer; empty reads the reviewer the den way: the rules reviewed and threads, with has_unresolved_findings of the Codex summary), secondPersonApproval (an APPROVE of the exact head by a person with write access who is not the author and who has no activity on the head branch in GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/activity opens the gate; never on a fork pull request), reviewTimeoutHours (a head with no gate status that many hours after its check finished gets the needs-human action "review by a person: approve head X?", reported only), and requireReviewGate (the new merge rule review-gate requires <statusPrefix>/review success). The function review-gate posts only a changed result. The gate status never counts as review evidence or as the check that ran. shepherd.go, dagger.toml and the workflows of den do not change, so with the empty settings the verdicts of den do not change. The design is in the PR description before the code, for MintRaven.
